confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on 2026 web sources of mixed quality and dates, not July-specific data. Restaurant meals and cappuccino are the firmest. Cocktail and wine are less certain: cocktail is a bounded estimate, and wine is a synthesis from sparse sources. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a July peak-season window, not checked against live listings. GBP-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.33 from model knowledge, not a searched rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: London is treated as its own high-cost UK benchmark. Food and drink anchors are based on 2026 London pub, restaurant and cost-of-living sources. Beer, wine and cocktail prices use local UK price levels, with cocktail and wine bounded from mid-range London bar and restaurant ranges. Accommodation is a model estimate reflecting London's high peak-season hotel and hostel rates.
